items.title: Convergence of the Kunneth spectral sequences for a bounded complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes convergence of the Kunneth spectral sequences associated with the total tensor product of a complex with a module, in the two cases of the statement. The proof is a 101-line argument that fixes the filtrations on the total complex, identifies the successive quotients of the induced spectral sequences with the expected Tor and Ext terms, and checks that the filtrations are finite in the bounded case so that the standard convergence criterion applies. The identification of the graded pieces is performed by hand for each filtration.
